newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends shade weaker vs dlr despite late rally.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends shade weaker vs dlr despite late rally.

text.p: The Hungarian forint ended slightly weaker against the dollar on Wednesday despite a late rally as the U.S. unit slipped back against the mark.
The Hungarian unit closed on the central bank's resistance level at 168.80/85, compared to an opening of 168.65/70.

"The forint went as low as 169.10 at one point but domestically it was a boring day as everyone followed the dollar/mark," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank, adding that the flat home picture would continue for the foreseeable future.

With the forint floating against a currency basket made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the dollar the Hungarian unit's movements are inversely proportional to shifts in the dollar/mark cross.

Moderately large turnover in the currency futures section of the Budapest Commodity Exchange was shared mainly between the mark and the Ecu, which both ended mostly down while sterling and the dollar moved up for almost all maturities.
